notes.title: Patch 18.15 - Reality Shift Difficulty Increase
notes.content:
Hi all,

Reason why I'm making this new post so soon after last patch is because this is it's own separate changes to experiment if it should stay or revert back to 18.1. This patch is primarily focused towards increasing the difficulty of Reality Shift, and also in turn a feature that is in Most Wanted too. 

[h2]Difficulty Increase[/h2]
After extensively playing the mode, I realised that the difficulty was not that high and you could practically always be back at max health within seconds of shooting a couple of police ships. Therefore, I have made it so you have to shoot [b]3[/b] ships to recover one segment of health. This makes it much more crucial to focus on enemy ships before shooting through the deities. This will also apply to Most Wanted but obviously, this patch is for testing and if it gets negative feedback, it will be reverted to 18.1 after a couple of days. notes.title: No Escape | Patch #18
notes.content:
Hi all,

My break will still be in effect... I hope! This is the [b]last[/b] major content update before I take my break from working on this to start on another game. This update revamps Reality Shift from Patch 17 and adds new twists to the mode. I have also done a few quality of life fixes such as fixing that damn timer! Hope you all enjoy. 

[h2]Reality Shift: Gravity Pull[/h2]
Fight the Reality Deity with a new mechanic to the game, gravity pull. Just like a blackhole, this mechanic pulls you towards the deity, making things much harder. The intensity of the pull is light at a range, and when you get closer, the pull gets more intense. Make use of your boosters and keep your distance from the middle! 

[h2]Reality Shift: Volcanic Residual Rework[/h2]
Compared to the Frozen, Volcanic felt really under-powered in both this mode and even as a Deity. Overall, he was pretty easy to dodge and posed no threat compared to Frozen's abilities. Therefore, he is now equipped with a volcanic flamethrower that is lethal when you're in close proximity, so keep an eye out! To balance this, he has 25% less health than the frozen deity and has a short range attack. 

[h3]Player Card[/h3]
Personally, I really dislike how I've implemented Stats into this game, also requiring you to go into a separate menu to claim achievements based on specific stats. Therefore, your very own player card has made it's way onto the menu! This displays everything the stats menu did, including your current balance, from the comfort of the menu. Certain achievements will also unlock on the menu if you meet the requirements. Hopefully, this is a worthy QoL fix that will make tracking your progress better. 

[h3]Money Clicker v1.5[/h3]
Since I added Money Clicker, rewards for completing modes has soared by over 10 times the amount, and this mode became obsolete. I mean, making $5 every 12 clicks is terrible when one Red Light game earns you $500. Therefore, while it's not a [b]major[/b] increase, you can now earn a maximum of $20 every 7 clicks. [b]And[/b], I removed any traces of the anti-cheat that disabled auto-clicker for a couple of people. 

Note that I [b]am[/b] planning on making a v2 when I return from my break, with 5 more tiers per upgrade.

notes.title: The Deities Update: Reality | Patch #17
notes.content:
Hi all,

Before I take my long break from this game, I felt like adding one more final content update for the time being. This finalises my original idea of the trio of deities. In Patch 9, I introduced the volcanic deity and his knights. In Patch 10, I introduced the frozen deity and his icicle spears. 7 major patches later, I bring you the Reality Deity, specific for the Most Wanted's new mode, Reality Shift and the residuals of Volcanic and Frozen.

[h3]New Mode: Reality Shift[/h3]
Added as a Most Wanted expansion, Reality Shift sets the stage for the final fight of the deities. The boss for it, while not too harmful, is incredibly durable and is surrounded by your typical police force. But note! It costs $7,500 to enter, with a $20,000 payout if you win.

[h3]New Boss: Reality Deity[/h3]
[b]Featured in Reality Shift[/b]
After defeating the other deities of Mayhem, destroying countless asteroids and defying the law, you must now overcome the Reality Deity. You must destroy this to pass Reality Shift and destroy the S.E.S once and for all.  

[h3]New Mini-Boss: Frozen Residual[/h3]
[b]Featured in Reality Shift[/b]
Orbiting Reality Deity is a residual of the frozen deity. On impact, your engines will be disabled, with the only way of moving being using your boost! This deity also shoots a frozen icicle every 25 seconds so prioritise killing this one off before anything else. 

[h3]New Mini-Boss: Volcanic Residual[/h3]
[b]Featured in Reality Shift[/b]
Orbiting Reality Deity is a residual of the volcanic deity. On impact, you will lose a significant 2 lives, so be warned!

[/list]

Minor update here, which brings an improved experimental stage to the boss fights which more information is shown below.

[h3]Boss Fights: Mini-Stage[/h3]
Ever wondered why the frozen deity had a little line in the health bar? It's because I always had the idea of the boss fight getting a bit harder for the final push against it but never implemented it. With this update, both bosses now have this line and they both have a purpose! When the Volcanic reaches this line, it gains a speed boost of 50% meaning you'll need to utilise your plasma field. notes.title: Patch 16.5 - New and Improved Achievements
notes.content:
Hi all,

Today's update overhauls how achievements work, removing and improving many of the existing ones as well as including new ones. One example is that previously with the "Reach Player Level 50", you had to go to stats to unlock it, which isn't practical to new players. This update allows you to constantly unlock achievements such as these as well as others while playing, removing the need to follow such specific unlock conditions.

I've also removed a few of the spammy, easy to get achievements such as one practically awarding you for pressing play and replaced them with more fulfilling ones you have to work towards!

In total this update brings:[list]
[*] 10 new achievements
[*] 16 improved achievements[/list]

And the best part is for all these overhauled achievements that previously existed, [b]they'll automatically unlock upon launch![/b] I hope to add a few more next update but for now that is all.

Thanks for supporting the game and myself,
Sep

notes.title: Combat Update | Patch #16
notes.content:
Hi all,

This update includes 2 brand new abilities for your disposal against the mindless asteroids or the sentient battleships. Burst through their defences with rapid fire, dodge their attacks in slow motion, or just collect the plenty new achievements! 

[h2]Progressive Achievements[/h2]
After a lot of tinkering with the Steamworks API and achievement system, I've finally managed to add progressive stat achievements. This means that I can include long-term achievements such as "Win 10 games in total" with ease and all you have to do is play and not mess with any save system! I'm still learning the best ways to make use of this but for now, I've added 11 new achievements for completionists, giving you more to do than ever. 

[h2]New Ability: Fast Reflex[/h2]
[b]Available in: Classic, Most Wanted[/b]
Introducing Fast Reflex, an ability which slows down time for 2 seconds, allowing you to dodge incoming asteroids with no problems. Everything else slows down, while you remain faster than the enemies, with a low cooldown of 15s!

[h2]New Ability: Heavy Barrel[/h2]
[b]Available in: Classic, Most Wanted[/b]
Also with this update comes Heavy Barrel, an ability which doubles your firing speed for 2 seconds, giving you the opportunity to destroy enemies in quick succession. The trade off is that this ability has a cooldown of 45s, so use it only when you need it.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]New[/h3][list]
[*] Added 11 Achievements
[*] Added Fast Reflex ability
[*] Added Heavy Barrel ability[/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list]
[*] Updated Gamemodes List
[*] Updated Controls List[/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed Repair Bar on Mayhem not working correctly
[/list]

[h2]Regarding Search and Destroy[/h2]
After playing some Search and Destroy for a while, as it has been neglected since I created it, I've come to realise that honestly, its boring as hell compared to the other options, with the only reason to play it for achievements. Therefore, this update removes the mode and achievements that come with it. The gamemode may be added back in the future, or replaced with a new idea, but for now it will remain empty.

notes.title: Patch 15.5 - New Mechanic, Normal Mode, Boss Grace Period

Hi all,

It's been a long 4 months since the last productive patch but I deliver some good news, Patch 15.5! This patch brings back Normal mode for Classic, with (hopefully) all boss fight bugs that existed, fixed! I also bring a QoL feature to make boss fights more bearable and a new mechanic! Hope you enjoy. 

[h2]Boss Spawn Protection[/h2]
The most requested feature I've had is to fix the volcanic deity practically spawning on you and instantly ruining your run. With this update, I've finally done some tweaks to make this issue, no longer an issue. From now on, you will get a 1.5s invincibility protection at the start of a boss fight and a higher chance for the boss to spawn further away. There may be issues caused by this but if there are, I'll sort them out. I hope this makes the game more enjoyable! 

[h2]Visibility Beacon[/h2]
[b]Available in: Classic, Most Wanted, Search and Destroy[/b]
Your ship has now been equipped with a new upgrade! Featuring the Beacon, no longer needing to linger in the dark, you can take on asteroids or enemies with full awareness! Press "N" to activate the new feature, but be warned, you'll lose 60% speed when turned on. Is the trade off worth it late game?

notes.title: The Most Wanted Update | Patch #13
notes.content:
Hi all,

This patch features a new mode for you to all experiment with. Please note that this new mode will need EXTENSIVE testing, trial and error, before it’s fully suitable and completed. This is my first time making an enemy AI like this before which chases to close range, shoots and more, meaning that it may seem too strong or weak at times.

[h2]New Mode: Most Wanted[/h2]
[b]Playable in Arcade[/b]
[b]Rewards: 30XP[/b]
The Space Enforcement Service (SES) patrols and protects all parts of space from planet damage to unusual activity. After witnessing you destroying thousands of asteroids when you were stranded, you have made yourself a high-risk suspect, which needs destroying. In this mode, cornered by agents of the SES, your primary objective is to survive 3 minutes until your nuclear bomb is ready and discharge it, clearing a path to escape. Take out waves of SWAT teams, siphon health from enemy ships, and do whatever it takes to survive. 

[h2]Most Wanted's Wave System[/h2]
Most Wanted adapts a new wave system which is utilised with the base spawning system used with the asteroids. While normal SES officers will spawn with the old system, other variants of enemies will spawn at dedicated times throughout the 3 minutes. Below are all the timings. [list]
[*] 3x SES Patrol Officers spawn every 3 seconds
[*] 5x SES SWAT Officers spawn every 30 seconds
[*] 1x SES CQ Specialist spawns every 15 seconds
[*] 1x SES Brute spawns at the 2 minute mark
[/list]
[h2]New Enemy: SES Patrol Officer[/h2]
Patrol officers are the base enemy you'll spend the majority of time fighting against. They move slightly slower than the player, have a range of 9m, and deals 1 damage per 2 seconds. They are a one-bullet kill.

[h2]New Enemy: SES SWAT Officer[/h2]
SWAT officers arrive every 30 seconds as a group and will be a pain against if you've let too many patrol officers swarm the area. They move a bit slower compared to the Patrol Officers, have a range of 11m, and deals 1 damage per 1 second. They are a one-bullet kill.

[h2]New Enemy: SES CQ Specialist[/h2]
Close-quarters specialists deal devastating damage up close and are fast. They move slightly faster than the player, have a range of 2m, and deals 5 damage per second. They are a one-bullet kill.

[h2]New Enemy: SES Brute[/h2]
The Brute is the toughest officer to go against. They move extremely slowly, however have a range of 10m, and deals 10 damage per second. They are a ten-bullet kill.

For each [b]full numbered[/b] patch, will come a brand new mode to Arcade. For Patch 11, this is Rescue Operations. It'll make more sense as modes come out. Once I'm done with Rescue Operations and I'm satisfied with the content, there will be an announcement for it's completion and we will move onto Patch 12, which will be an entirely new mode. [h3]Mayhem Mode 2.0[/h3]
With Mayhem 2.0, the reinforced asteroids leave as I feel like they didn't really add anything unique, especially after adding the Volcanic Knights which were identical. To celebrate the end of the 4 year early access period, I present Rocky Mayhem: Lights Out! notes.title: Dev Log #1 - Difficulty Scaling, Full-Auto, Shield Upgrade, Anti-Cheat
notes.content:
Hi all!

I've decided to do a dev log to expand on my reasons for the anti-cheat, as well as talk about what's coming next in the days to come, including a substitution for auto-clicking to make the game easier!

[h1]Difficulty Scaling[/h1]
Next patch will introduce Difficulty Scaling to make the gameplay experience slightly harder. Currently, asteroids spawn at a fixed rate at a fixed amount with no variation, meaning that the game is slightly too easy as of current. Achievement progression is slow, score and kill progression is slow, and you can play without needing to move. 

With the introduction of difficulty scaling, for every minute that you're alive the asteroid spawn rate will slightly increase by small amounts. For every 5 minutes that you're alive, the amount of asteroids that spawn at a time will be increased by around 2-3. Hopefully with this, it'll make the game more challenging and more viable for longer play sessions. Now with Anti-Cheat preventing auto-clickers, you may be wondering how will it be possible late-game with your fingers not keeping up with clicking each and every asteroid. Well...

[h1]Full-Auto Weaponry[/h1]
With Difficulty Scaling, full-auto guns will make the game much more balanced as the game gets harder. At the start of the game, the firerate will be slow, firing about 1 bullet every 0.7 seconds. Implemented and adapted for Difficulty Scaling, for every minute that you're alive the firerate will increase by a small amounts (capping at 0.2s cooldown). I believe the addition of Full-Auto gunning and Difficulty Scaling, the game will become more fair while challenging. However, what if there's too many asteroids to handle?

[h1]Shield Level 2[/h1]
While not arriving with Difficulty Scaling, the level 2 variant of the shield will be arriving with Patch #5. Once you survive for 3 minutes, the shield component of your ship will automatically upgrade to Level 2, providing a way to [b]destructively[/b] protect your ship against asteroids. More to be announced later.

[h1]Regards to Anti-Cheat[/h1]
Thanks for some feedback regarding the anti-cheat. I understand that it made the game easier as you no longer had to click a thousand times. This is why full-auto is coming to the game! This new mechanic will eradicate the need for auto-clickers, removing any need to even be considering using one. With the full-auto update, the anti-cheat will also become more strict. This will lead to detecting auto-clickers earlier and punishing cheaters faster. 

However, if the full-auto weaponry doesn't please some, then I'll consider removing Anti-Cheat!

That's all for today! Keep updated by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/XYTVwRZ8]discord[/url]

notes.content:
Hi all.

Recently since I introduced steam achievements, I've seen a few users using an auto-clicker to unlock many achievements. This disappoints me because Steam Achievements were implemented for the community to challenge each other and see who could achieve the most achievements. Therefore I introduce...

If detected, a window will pop-up alerting you that an auto-clicker was detected and achievements will be disabled. The only way to fix this is restarting your game and disabling your auto-clicker. This is one I coded in myself so if there's any unjustified disabling of achievements, please link me a video of you playing and I'll review it myself.

I hope this will solve the problems of auto-clicking to cheat achievements!

notes.content:
Hey guys! So I've composed a brief and summarised road-map for what I want to add into the game at the end of each month in fortnightly updates before the end of Early Access. I hope this gives you guys an idea of what Rocky Mayhem will look like by the end of EA. 

Once the next update releases, I'll create a more visually pleasing one but here's a summary of what I want to have in Rocky Mayhem by the end of every month.

[h2]May[/h2]
As May is almost over, and I'm currently on a Birthday break, I haven't really been able to get anything major done since the release update. Therefore, there will be a [i]balance update[/b] coming to the game tomorrow changing a lot of how the game works. Patch notes will come out when the update is live. 

[h2]June[/h2]
By the end of June, I want to focus on polishing the gameplay, making adjustments to different mechanics as well as adding new content. I've seen that some people have been able to complete the game in 5-10 minutes so I have a mission of adding; 10 new levels, 3 new asteroids, 2 new game modes (including 'Endless') and experimenting the possibility of having mass-scale maps to have a future 'Search and Destroy' mission type. 

[h2]July[/h2]
For the end of July, I want to have a foundation built for enemy AI ships as well as adding a bit more enjoyment to the game where possible. The objective for July will be to add time-limited powerups and to complete Chapter 2 with; 2 new asteroids, a new weapon type, 5 new levels, 1 new boss battle and a cutscene. Anyways, august should be the final month of Early Access before they become monthly updates SO I want to add the upcoming expansion Rocky Mayhem: The Showdown. The game will also be leaving early access as I start the course. This means, once a month there will be an update containing; bug patches, balances, 3 new levels and level redesigns. By level redesigns, I mean on a monthly basis, all levels will be changed slightly to add replayablity. Some months there will be a few more asteroids, a few less or a complete change of spawn. 

Hope this covers everything,
See you in the next update :)
